regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (block titled NATIONAL; locator map shades all of Sri Lanka purple)
regions.notes: The inter-monsoon columns (Mar-Apr, Oct-Nov) are a lighter blue than the monsoon columns, but they are labelled inter-monsoon, not showers, so they are not flagged minor. The Northeast Monsoon is shaded Jan-Feb (labelled) and Dec (labelled 'NE Monsoon'); recorded as one 12-2. The lean box runs from mid-Oct to Dec and on through Jan (two pieces at the year edge, one season). The Maha harvest is drawn as mid-Dec to Dec plus Jan to Mar (one harvest 12-3). Vegetables S1 runs mid-Jan to Feb and S2 Aug to mid-Sep. Cash-crop harvests are labelled with the crop only: tea in two separate blocks, rubber Sep-Jan, coconut May-Aug, fruits Mar-Aug.

assign.method: Single national calendar, so every province maps to national.

transcriber_notes: Rainy-season links are judgement calls. Maha planting (Sep-Nov) falls in the 2nd Inter-monsoon and its harvest (Dec-Mar) at the end of the Northeast Monsoon. The Maha crop grows across both, so harvest is linked to the Northeast Monsoon and planting to the 2nd Inter-monsoon. Likewise Yala planting (Mar-May) is linked to the 1st Inter-monsoon and its Jul-Sep harvest to the Southwest Monsoon.
